text:
Maria: quick sync — we need a lightweight, zero-touch validator for marketplace Terraform stacks so partners can self-validate before publishing. can folks volunteer owners? :wave:
Kunal: i can take the core smoke tests. thinking terratest for infra + a small infraless smoke that calls the redwood endpoint.
Priya: +1. add pre-commit hooks: tflint, tfsec, and a policy guard (opa/conftest) for allowed resources. also require MODULE_METADATA.md with marketplace fields.
Alex: are there packaging constraints from marketplace side (cloudformation shims, asset bundling)? i can pull the AWS/GCP checklist and add to the repo. @Maria do we need a minimal example snippet for partners?
Maria: yes please @Alex, minimal examples for aws/gcp + a provider-agnostic example. also need docs for how to run local validator and CI.
Kunal: plan suggestion:
1) module smoke: terraform init/apply against test account (cheap infra)
2) functional smoke: run a small container that hits the partner endpoint (or redwood staging) to validate runtime wiring
3) lint/policy: pre-commit + opa policies
we can keep the infra small (one VM or serverless function) to keep costs low.
Priya: add a mandatory outputs section in modules: {marketplace_name, version, support_contact} so automation can read metadata.
Sam: for the functional smoke, we should use a short lived API key and call a simple generation/health endpoint. env var REDWOOD_API_KEY should be masked in CI. also include a minimal curl example in the README.
Alex: here's a tiny example for the partner starter module to include in the repo:```hcl
module "redwood_inference" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/refkit//terraform/modules/marketplace-starter?ref=v0.1.0"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
  marketplace_metadata = {
    name    = "partner-quickstart"
    version = "0.1.0"
  }
}
```
DevInfraBot: CI pipeline created: marketplace-iac-validator (id: pipeline-4821). automated PR checks: fmt -> tflint -> plan -> terratest smoke.
Maria: awesome, thanks. next steps: @Kunal create smoke test scaffold, @Alex add marketplace packaging checklist, @Priya add policy rules + metadata schema, @Sam add functional curl example and CI secret handling notes. i'll assemble a short owner-runbook and share by EOD.
Kunal: starting branch now, will tag PR with "validator: initial" when ready.
Priya: i'll draft OPA rules and add examples for common disallowed patterns (public s3, wide sg).
Alex: grabbing AWS/GCP checklist and will drop in ./docs/marketplace-packaging.md by tomorrow.
Sam: i'll add the curl + GH Actions snippet for secret masking.
Maria: thanks team :thumbsup: putting a 30min sync on calendar for tomorrow 09:30 PT to unblock any blockers. if you can't make it, drop blockers here.
Kunal: noted.
Priya: thanks, see you tomorrow.
Alex: cheers.
DevInfraBot: reminder set for meeting (2950013500).
